question: Who among the following was the flag bearer of the Indian contingent at the opening ceremony of the Asian Games 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** was the** flag bearer **of the Indian contingent at the **opening ceremony** of the **Asian Games 2018.**
 
• The Asian Games is a **multi-sport event** held **every four years,** featuring athletes from across Asia.
 
• The** 2018 Asian Games **were held in **Jakarta and Palembang, Indonesia, **from **August 18 to September 2**.
 
• The Indian contingent at the 2018 Asian Games consisted of** 570 athletes across 36 sports.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saina Nehwal** is a **badminton player** who has won numerous medals at international events.

 
 
• She won a bronze at the **2012 London Olympics **and a** gold at the 2018 Commonwealth Games.**
 
 
 
• **Bajrang Punia** is a** wrestler**.
 
 
• He won **gold **at the 2018 Asian Games in the 65 kg freestyle category.
 
 
 
• **PT Usha **is a **former track and field athlete**.
 
• She represented India at the Olympics and **Asian Games in the 1980s and 1990s. **
